description.p: Top Player is a high-performance, lightweight native media player for Linux powered by Qt6 and libmpv, with a borderless cyan-on-obsidian skin and a keyboard-driven workflow.

ul.li: Borderless dark skin with an on-screen display
Seekbar with hover preview thumbnails
Playlist manager: folders, sorting, shuffle, search, M3U, session restore
Audio view with album art, metadata and visualizations
Dual subtitles, subtitle delay and position hotkeys
Subtitle search and download from OpenSubtitles.com
10-band audio equalizer with presets
Hardware-accelerated decoding through mpv
Packages for Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 and 26.04, Debian 13, openSUSE Tumbleweed and Leap 16.0, and Arch Linux, next to the AppImage, Flatpak and Fedora RPM
Builds with Qt 6.2
Reopening a file left halfway asks whether to resume or start over (or always does one, as set)
Synced lyrics: downloads from LRCLIB (lyrics.ovh as fallback), a karaoke-style view that centers and highlights the sung line, lyrics files next to the song or loaded by hand
A ready-made AI prompt (title, artist, length) for songs no lyrics site has, with Paste AI Answer
Tap-to-sync editor for lyrics and subtitles, with undo, nudging, slow playback and LRC / SRT export
Custom audio artwork now shows even while a visualizer is selected, and an image dropped on a playing song becomes its cover
The keyboard's media keys (play/pause, next, previous, stop) work through MPRIS, also from the desktop's media controls
Drag sideways over the video, or scroll sideways, to seek
Opened media starts playing right away
Opening a folder while a playlist plays replaces it instead of adding to it
Library folders and playlists can be clicked open and folded
New window buttons (always on top, minimize, maximize, fullscreen, close) and a PotPlayer-style playlist bar with move, ADD, DEL and SORT
Lighter playback: fewer position updates and repaints, no playlist rebuild when the next entry starts
Live TV plays channels that need a referrer or user agent, and tries a channel's other streams when one fails
Live TV covers every country, with All Countries, a category filter and Hide geo-blocked
The playlist opens in fullscreen too
Shuffle, repeat (all or one) and aspect (fit, 16:9, 100%) buttons on the control bar
Opening a playlist keeps its titles, skips missing files and reports what was opened
Renamed to Top Player, with a new icon and a cyan and obsidian skin
About dialog with version, credits and system details (F1)
Click the video to pause, double-click for fullscreen
Adding large folders and playlists no longer freezes the window
10-band audio equalizer with presets
Subtitle search and download from OpenSubtitles.com, with movie hash matching
Audio files show their cover art and metadata, or a waveform or spectrum visualization
Playlist manager: add folders, sort, shuffle, remove missing files and duplicates, search, save and open M3U playlists, restore the last session
Fix turning subtitles off from the Subtitle Track menu
